statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (u k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); let C (A : Set ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) := intervalIntegral (A.indicator (fun t => (S n u t)^2 * E (-(n : ℝ)*t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ (A : Set ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → ‖C A n u - C A n v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (u k-v k)^2) * Real.sqrt (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (u k+v k)^2)
